name: dsh-profile-duplocode-control
description: DuploCode control-plane DSH profile. A composition LAYER placed under $DSH_HOME/profiles/duplocode-control that selects which DSH bundles mount for an operator/worker runtime. Installing it deploys a DSH configuration; it confers NO governance authority: admission, leases, worker lifecycle, independent verification, verdicts, evidence, attestation, and publication remain owned by the @duplocode control plane and are not granted to DSH or to the dsh-web-app surface this profile mounts.
